content.text:
=== dev-services.yaml ===
http:
  routers:
    backend-dev:
      rule: "Host(`localhost`) && (PathPrefix(`/api`) || PathPrefix(`/swagger-ui`) || PathPrefix(`/api-docs`))"
      entryPoints: [web]
      service: backend-dev
    frontend-dev:
      rule: "Host(`localhost`)"
      entryPoints: [web]
      service: frontend-dev
  services:
    backend-dev:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: "http://host.docker.internal:3030"
    frontend-dev:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: "http://host.docker.internal:5173"
=== search auth.localhost references ===
./compose.yaml:43:          - auth.localhost
./backend/config/local.yaml:10:  issuer_url: "http://auth.localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution"
./README.md:102:| Keycloak | <http://auth.localhost:3000> |

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== dev-services.yaml ==="; cat .docker/infra/traefik/dynamic/dev-services.yaml; echo "=== search auth.localhost references ==="; grep -rn "auth.localhost" --include="*.md" --include="*.yaml" --include="*.yml" --include="*.sh" --include="*.nix" --include="*.ts" --include="*.json" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -30
